authority: Protector General of Emigrants / Ministry of External Affairs

description.en: Emigration Clearance is required for Indian citizens with ECR (Emigration Check Required) passports who are travelling to specified countries for employment purposes. The clearance is processed through the eMigrate portal and ensures that the emigrant has a valid employment contract with a registered employer, protecting workers from exploitation and fraudulent recruitment.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: Indian citizens travelling abroad for employment to ECR-required countries
verifiedConditions.claim: Emigration clearance is required only for Indian passport holders whose passport has ECR (Emigration Check Required) status. ECNR (Emigration Check Not Required) passport holders do not need emigration clearance.
The applicant must have a valid employment visa or work permit for the destination country and a verified employment contract.

unverifiedEligibility: The list of ECR countries is subject to change — currently includes 18 countries primarily in the Middle East and Southeast Asia.
Certain categories of workers (such as those with educational qualifications above matriculation, government employees, and professionals) are exempt from ECR even without ECNR endorsement.
Emigration clearance may not be required for certain visa types (visit, tourist, student) even to ECR countries.

requirements.claim: Valid Indian passport with ECR endorsement and at least 6 months validity from the date of travel.
Valid employment visa or work permit for the destination country stamped on the passport.
Employment contract specifying job description, salary, working hours, accommodation, medical facilities, and other terms and conditions — verified by the employer registered on the eMigrate portal.
Registration on the eMigrate portal (emigrate.gov.in) by the emigrant, the recruiting agent (if applicable), and the foreign employer.
Pravasi Bharatiya Bima Yojana (PBBY) insurance policy — mandatory insurance cover for emigrant workers going to ECR countries.

processInformation.claim: Register on the eMigrate portal at emigrate.gov.in. The foreign employer and recruiting agent (if any) must also be registered on the portal.
Upload required documents on the eMigrate portal including passport copy, visa copy, employment contract, and PBBY insurance certificate.
The Protector of Emigrants (PoE) office verifies the documents, employment contract terms, and employer registration. The PoE may seek additional information or clarification.

Emigration clearance is granted electronically through the eMigrate portal. The clearance is stamped on the passport or available as a digitally signed certificate. The emigrant can check the status online.

output.claim: An Emigration Clearance is granted electronically, recorded on the eMigrate portal and endorsed on the passport. It authorises the passport holder to travel to the specified country for the specified employment. The clearance is typically valid for the duration of the employment visa.

fees.claim: There is no government fee for emigration clearance itself. However, the mandatory PBBY insurance premium (approximately Rs. 275-375 for a two-year policy) is a separate cost borne by the employer or recruiting agent and not by the emigrant.

processingTime.applicability: Emigration clearance from application to grant
processingTime.claim: Emigration clearance is typically processed within 3-7 working days through the eMigrate portal, provided all documents are in order and the employer/agent are verified and registered. Delays may occur if additional verification is required.

sources.title: eMigrate Portal — Official Emigration Clearance System
sources.publisher: Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: The eMigrate portal is the official system for processing emigration clearances for Indian workers travelling to ECR countries. It facilitates online registration, document upload, verification, and grant of clearance. Employers, recruiting agents, and emigrants must all register on the portal.
claimsSupported: Emigration clearance is processed online through eMigrate portal.
Required for ECR passport holders going to ECR countries for employment.
No government fee for clearance; PBBY insurance is mandatory.
sources.uncertainty: The list of ECR countries and exempt categories may be updated periodically.

claimsSupported: 18 countries are currently in the ECR list.
PBBY insurance is mandatory for emigrant workers.

sources.uncertainty: The Emigration Act 1983 may be replaced by new emigration legislation.

limitations: The list of ECR countries and ECNR exempt categories is subject to periodic revision.
This record focuses on employment-related emigration clearance. Other types of travel do not typically require emigration clearance.
The record does not cover country-specific visa requirements or work permit processes.
PBBY insurance terms and premium amounts may be revised.
The record does not cover the grievance redressal mechanism for emigrant workers.
If the proposed Emigration Bill is enacted, the clearance process may change.
